name: basic-machine-learning-models
title: Basic Machine Learning Models
description: Architecture blueprint for training, tracking, and serving ML models on Fabric: prepare features in a Lakehouse, run experiments with MLflow tracking, register the best model, and score data in batch or via an endpoint. Best for predictive analytics and data science workflows.
best_for: Data science teams training models on prepared data — experiment tracking, model registry/versioning, and batch or real-time scoring.
primary_storage: Lakehouse (features, training data, scored outputs as Delta)
key_ingestion: Copy Job / Pipeline (batch) into the Lakehouse; upstream medallion/basic-data-analytics often feeds this

item_set.purpose: Pinned ML libraries (scikit-learn, xgboost, …) for reproducible runs
Land + refresh training data on a schedule
Feature engineering, training loop, and scoring code
MLflow experiment: track runs, params, metrics, artifacts
Registered model with versions + serving endpoint
Optional model over scored outputs for BI

decisions.guidance: Notebooks for interactive/iterative training; Spark Job Definitions for packaged, scheduled retraining promoted through CI/CD.
Batch when predictions feed reports/pipelines on a schedule; endpoint when an app needs low-latency inference.
Experiment tracks training RUNS (params/metrics); Model is the registered, versioned artifact you promote and serve. See 'fabio context disambiguate model'.

build_with.deploy_ordering: Lakehouse + Environment (Foundation) before Notebook, then MLExperiment before MLModel; fabio deploy handles ordering.
outline: Create a lakehouse for features/training data (often fed by a medallion/basic-data-analytics upstream).
Create an Environment pinning ML libraries; bind the notebook to it.
Author a training notebook logging to an MLExperiment (MLflow).
Register the best run as an MLModel (version it); score in batch (notebook -> Delta) or expose an endpoint.
Optionally add a semantic model + report over the scored outputs.
